title: Restricted Fourier coefficient estimate
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $a,b$ be positive natural numbers with $2a\le b$. Given a Boolean function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, a subset $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, a subset $S\subseteq J$, and a sign assignment $z$ on $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\setminus J$, define the restricted Fourier coefficient estimate to be the average over the inner sample range of $f$ evaluated at the combined free and fixed assignments, multiplied by the character indexed by $S$ of the free assignment.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The inner sample range, free-assignment sampler, combination operation, and indexed character are not defined in the supplied descriptions.
